top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a single, mature achievement: proglucagon processing, identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) amide, and human incretin physiology (insulinotropic, glucagonostatic, satiety actions), confirmed independently for two decades and validated by outcome trials showing glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The Holst, Drucker and Mojsov allocation with a physiology-led citation is defensible, though omitting Knudsen's acylation chemistry and the contested priority relative to Habener's group remain real weaknesses. Even so, the work is clearly Nobel-level, so an award is preferable to no award.
